data.name: Sourin
data.gender_notes: Sourin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sourya', which means 'Sun'. It symbolizes the power and strength of the sun and is believed to bring success and victory to the bearer. The name Sourin carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Hindi. Parents who choose Sourin usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A divine name, representing the inner strength and power of the individual. It is believed to connect the bearer with the divine energy of the sun and inspire confidence and courage.
data.etymology: Sourin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sourin total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sourin holds a significant place in Hindu culture as it is inspired by the Sanskrit word for 'Sun'. Revered as a source of energy and vitality, the sun holds a special significance in Hinduism and is often personified as a deity, revered for his calming as well as energetic influences. A name derived from this term in Hindu culture is believed to bestow those same positive qualities - power, strength, and success.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Sourin symbolizes the divine and transformative power of the sun. It represents the transformative energy that can help individuals overcome challenges and grow spiritually. Additionally, it is a reminder of the ceaseless cycle of life and death, a notion that is central to Hinduism. By bearing this name, one may be inspired to harness the power of the sun to overcome obstacles and fulfill one's potential.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sourin is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sura', meaning 'god' or 'divine being'. The name Sourin signifies the inner divine presence and the potential for individuals to connect with and embody the divine qualities within themselves.

historical_references.reference: Sourin was a king of the ancient Indian kingdom of Kamarupa, in present-day Assam. He ruled during the 7th century AD and is known for his military conquests and religious patronage.

historical_references.reference: Sourin is also mentioned in the 12th century Sanskrit work 'Kalikapurana' as a great devotee of the goddess Kali. The text describes him as a powerful king who ruled over the regions of Assam and Bengal.
